settings.title: Caral Pyramid
settings.dropdown_text:
Caral is thought to be one of the oldest known cities in the Western Hemisphere. The Caral civilization was pre-Columbian. It remains a mystery as to why the city was abandoned.

One of the largest Pyramids in the complex is known as the Pirámide Mayor and is almost 100 feet tall and is considered to be as old as the Egyptian pyramids.

settings.title: Amaru Muru
settings.dropdown_text: Amaru Muru also known as “Hayu Marca or Willka Uta: “Place of the sun or gate of the gods.” This magnanimous rock structure is surrounded by mystery and ancient legends. A stunning doorway is carved into the ancient rock wall and faces east, toward Lake Titicaca, the Island of the Sun in Bolivia and the distant, sacred snow-capped mountains.

settings.title: Day 7 – Monday, February 9th - Nile Cruise & Valley of Kings & Queens
settings.text:
• Overnight in Luxor on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

Visit the west bank and see the most breathtaking beautifully preserved tomb in Egypt of Queen Nefertari in the Valley of the Queens.
settings.dropdown_text:
After this, we continue to experience the exquisite Temple of the female pharaoh Hatshepsut, one of the most beautiful masterpieces of the ancient world. Return to Cruise for Lunch.

We then continue to the Valley of the Kings with its deep subterranean tombs of the ancient Kings of Egypt.

settings.title: Day 8 – Tuesday, February 10th - Nile Cruise & Temples
settings.text:
• Overnight in Qena on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

Early morning visit to Karnak and a PRIVATE VISIT to see the Shrine of Sekhmet. We will explore Karnak Temple with its huge columns that reach to the stars.
settings.dropdown_text:
It was said that the ancient ones built these columns with special stones to collect and store the energies of their sacred singing and chanting that was done daily at dawn as the priests and priestess walked down the processional path to the Holies of Holies. Then daily the stored energy within the columns would fill the Temple spaces, energizing those who visited this sacred Temple throughout the day. We will be at the Seven Gates to Heaven door at Osiris temple.

Sail to Qena. After lunch we will visit Denderah Temple dedicated to Hathor, Goddess of love and joy. Experience the famous circular zodiac ceiling and secret crypts with enigmatic images. Denderah Temple was considered a university of higher learning and ancient Stargate and is still alive today.

settings.title: Day 9 – Wednesday, February 11th - Nile Cruise & Abydos
settings.text:
• Overnight in Luxor on Royal Lily Cruise
  • Breakfast, Lunch, & Dinner included

After breakfast, we drive by bus to visit Abydos. This amazing, beautiful Temple built by Seti I was dedicated to Osiris. It was considered a profound pilgrimage place and over the centuries pilgrims came with offering pots to ask for a blessing from the beloved god Osiris.
settings.dropdown_text:
Today it is one of the most amazing sites in Egypt. Abydos Temple was considered a university of higher learning and ancient Stargate and is still alive today.

We will have a PRIVATE VISIT to see the ancient mysterious Osireion mythological structure. Return for lunch and then sail back to Luxor.

settings.title: Timothy W. Hogan, Grandmaster of the Knights Templar
settings.text:
Timothy W. Hogan stands as a luminous presence within the Western Mystery Tradition—a Grand Master of the Order of the Temple of Secret Initiates, and a bridge between ancient initiatory lineages and today’s spiritual seekers Gaiacontactinthedesert.com.

With decades of study and initiation in Freemasonry, Rosicrucianism, Martinism, and Templar orders, Tim has dedicated his life to reviving the sacred teachings of these traditions for the modern soul GaiaScribd. He is author of deeply influential works such as The Alchemical Keys to Masonic Ritual, The Way of the Templar, The 32 Secret Paths of Solomon, and Entering the Chain of Union—each exploring the spiritual architecture behind ritual, symbol, and initiation Gaiacontactinthedesert.com.

A sought-after lecturer and emissary of wisdom, Timothy has spoken at universities, embassies, and Masonic bodies across the globe, and has graced screens and airwaves through television, podcasts, and documentary series—including Gaia’s own Mysteries of the Knights Templar and Ancient Civilizations Gaiacontactinthedesert.comEverand.

Bringing rare and sacred insights into the Yucatán Adventure journey, Tim serves as both guide and initiate—ready to lead you beyond the surface into a realm of remembrance, renewal, and awakening.

settings.title: What is included in the tour package?
settings.text: The tour includes expert guidance by Maria Wheatley, transportation from Hotel Europa to all sites, dowsing tuition, interaction with Earth energies, and ferry costs to Gozo. Accommodation, meals, and flights are not included, allowing flexibility for participants to arrange their own travel.

settings.title: Do I need any prior experience with dowsing or Earth energy work?
settings.text: No experience is required! Maria Wheatley will provide dowsing tuition and guide participants in connecting with Earth energies at each temple complex.

settings.title: How many megalithic temples are in Malta?
settings.text: Malta is home to seven megalithic temple sites, recognized as UNESCO World Heritage Sites. These include Ġgantija, Ħaġar Qim, Mnajdra, Tarxien, Ta' Ħaġrat, Skorba, and Borg in-Nadur.

settings.title: What is the history behind the megalithic temples of Malta?
settings.text: Dating back to 3600–2500 BCE, Malta’s megalithic temples are among the oldest free-standing structures, predating the pyramids and Stonehenge. Built by a prehistoric civilization, they were used for religious and astronomical rituals. Their advanced architecture, including corbelled walls, altars, and carvings, showcases the engineering skills of Malta’s early builders.
